item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.3

  • Watchlist & Portfolio Performance: Streamlined render hot paths by decoupling expensive chart calculations, pre-calculating portfolio snapshots and backfill history, eliminating layout thrashing and scroll lag.
  • Watchlist Drag & Drop Reordering: Polished drag handle, cursor transitions, and half-split drop targets across compact and wide table views without layout jank.
  • Watchlist Wide Header & Layout Gap Fix: Fixed unconstrained header whitespace and preserved table hierarchy / scroll position across symbol selections.
  • Build & Installation Fixes: Dynamically resolved release binary output directory in install scripts for seamless app installation.
